member: Priya — Power, Avionics and Lunar Environment Engineer
message:
Mara, Theo and Sam, the half-hour sortie needs a small portable store not a household day. Energy is power times time, and the sortie energy (E32) is 171 Watt-hour (Wh) meaning energy from 341 Watt (W) meaning power for 0.5 hour, not 1000 Wh, like a small e-bike pack not a home battery.

Mara, Theo and Sam, the old pack claim fails everyday pack scale against datasheets. The implied pack specific energy (E33) is 342 Wh per kilogram (kg) meaning mass for 1000 Wh in 2.92 kg, about three times normal scale, against the pack density (E34) at 90.6 Wh per kg from bioennopower.com — 24V 20Ah LiFePO4 Battery – Bioenno Power (E27) and the PowerTech density (E35) at 120 Wh per kg from actec.dk — 24v Lithium-Ion battery pack (E23), where Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) meaning olivine battery chemistry packs run near 90 to 120 Wh per kg.

Mara, Theo and Sam, a purchasable pack closes power and heat with mass to spare. The runtime at full load (E36) is 1.41 hour at 341 W from 480 Wh, and the reconciled mass (E37) is 53.0 kg under the 60 kg limit like large luggage, so sealed-box heat and dust stay test tuning once geometry closes. I am not ready, because the rear lift tip and stowed fit proof in blocking objection (O2) stays open.
